threeConcepts.title: LE GUÉ DES CORBEAUX
threeConcepts.logline: A scarred veteran and a green conscript hold a river ford against a cavalry column long enough for a refugee column to cross; it ends in a duel with the enemy champion.
threeConcepts.setting: stone ford, misty northern river valley, dawn; iron/dark-age ambiguous (original)
threeConcepts.dramaticPotential: HIGH (clear stakes, ticking clock, mentor/pupil, one iconic duel)
threeConcepts.feasibilityAI: HIGH (1-2 locations, 2-3 hero faces, controlled duel; crowds kept distant/misty => mitigates the SC22 crowd-artifact failure L4)

threeConcepts.title: LA MEUTE DE FER
threeConcepts.logline: Steppe horse-archers raid a fortified caravan; a lone guard turns the hunters into the hunted across open grassland.
threeConcepts.setting: open steppe, golden grass, big sky
threeConcepts.feasibilityAI: MED-LOW (many horses+riders in motion => high crowd+motion+horse-identity drift risk)

threeConcepts.title: DEUX LAMES, UN SERMENT
threeConcepts.logline: Two sword-brothers on opposite sides of a siege; betrayal forces a final duel on the breach as the city burns.
threeConcepts.feasibilityAI: MED (siege crowds/VFX; core is a lockable 2-person duel; crowds as background/smoke)

comparison: C1 best balances drama x AI-feasibility x cost: fewest hero faces, one geography (easy continuity), controlled duel motion, crowds distant/misted (avoids L4). C2 is the riskiest for current AI (horse+crowd motion). C3 is strong but siege crowds add risk/cost.

recommended.title: LE GUÉ DES CORBEAUX
recommended.audience: action/historical-drama viewers on YouTube; a 10-min POC toward a feature
recommended.firstSecondsPromise: a lone armoured silhouette on a stone ford at dawn; hoofbeats swell; he draws one blade as the cavalry crests the far bank — the whole film promised in one shot

synopsis: VEIG (40s, scarred veteran) is ordered to hold the ford of Krabba with a handful of tired men while the valley folk cross behind him. Among them: OTR (18, his dead friend's son, first battle). The enemy sends RANULF, their champion, to force the ford. Veig trades ground for time, teaching Otr to read the water and the line; men fall. When the refugees are nearly across, Ranulf challenges Veig on the ford itself. Veig wins by reading the river, not by strength — then chooses to let the beaten Ranulf live, buying the last families their crossing. Veig stays on the far bank as the ford floods; Otr leads the people on. The oath passes to the boy.

beats: Otr's fear; Veig's rule "read the water, not the man"
a man lost to a flanking rider (cost)
Ranulf arrives; the line breaks; refugees still crossing
the duel on the ford (central set-piece)
Veig wins by the river, spares Ranulf
the ford floods; Veig stays; Otr leads the people out
button: Otr draws the blade the way Veig taught — oath passed

characterBible.canon: man ~40s, scarred veteran; worn ring-mail over wool; a single notched longsword; grey-streaked beard; economical, watchful
characterBible.arc: duty -> choice (spares the enemy to buy time)

characterBible.canon: youth ~18; too-big mail; a short seax; open fearful face; grows calm
enemy champion ~35; heavy scale + horsehair-crest helm; a long war-blade; proud

actionBible.palette: cold steel-grey water + iron, warm dawn gold on the far ridge; blood kept dark/minimal
actionBible.light: low dawn sun through river mist; motivated
actionBible.crowdRule: enemy column stays MID/FAR + in mist (avoid dense foreground faces = L4)
actionBible.weaponContinuity: Veig longsword (one notch), Otr seax, Ranulf long war-blade — locked per reference
actionBible.horses: kept to the FAR bank / silhouettes where possible (limit horse-motion artifacts)

movementContracts.initial: Veig low guard mid-ford, Ranulf blade high on the near stones
movementContracts.trajectory: Ranulf overhead cut; Veig parries high, steps INSIDE on the submerged stone
movementContracts.contact: blades bind; Veig rolls his wrist, Ranulf's blade skates off into the water
movementContracts.consequence: Ranulf overbalanced on the slick stone, down to one knee
movementContracts.final: Veig behind/above, point at Ranulf's throat, both soaked
movementContracts.raccord: cut to reverse: the last refugee family reaching the far bank (why he spares him)

movementContracts.initial: Otr isolated, a rider bearing down along the shallows
movementContracts.trajectory: rider's spear thrust; Veig crosses frame, shoulders Otr clear
movementContracts.contact: spear misses; Veig hooks the rider's leg, rider into the water
movementContracts.consequence: Otr down but alive; rider unhorsed
movementContracts.final: Veig hauls Otr up by the collar; back-to-back
movementContracts.raccord: match-cut on the splash to the enemy column still coming

acceptanceCriteria.weapons: same weapon per character across shots (notch/length consistent)
acceptanceCriteria.horses: no morphing/extra legs; kept distant where possible
acceptanceCriteria.camera: motivated moves only; action legible at edit speed
acceptanceCriteria.movement: each action beat matches its movement contract (initial->contact->final)
acceptanceCriteria.continuity: geography of the ford consistent; eyelines hold; blood/costume consistent
